official.description: The Bekker NAWA Programme supports the international mobility of PhD students, scientists and academic teachers from Polish scientific units in pursuit of scientific excellence by enabling them to conduct research in renowned foreign institutions around the world. For young scientists it is also an opportunity for postdoctoral fellowships, while for PhD students it can be part of their education.
official.program_type: Outgoing international research mobility fellowship for Polish-based researchers
official.english_requirement: Applications must be prepared entirely in English.

verification.notes: Read directly on NAWA's own programme, about-the-programme, announcement (call No 12/2025 of 13 March 2026) and news pages. None of these publishes a monetary figure - the scholarship amount is set in the Regulations appendix, which is a downloadable document rather than a page figure. The URL stored in the catalogue (nawa.gov.pl/en/scientists/bekker) returns 404; the live page is /en/scientists/the-bekker-programme.

applicant_utility.summary: NAWA never publishes the Bekker stipend as a page figure - it sits inside the Regulations appendix, so download that document from the call folder before you plan a budget. The award is designed for outgoing mobility: you must already be a PhD student, scientist or academic teacher at a Polish institution, and you can only submit one application per call for one host centre, so choose that host deliberately. Applications must be written entirely in English and go through the NAWA ICT system at programs.nawa.gov.pl, which means your referee and host-supervisor statements have to be collected and uploaded before the cut-off, not chased afterwards.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Polish-based PhD students, postdocs and academic teachers who already have a named foreign host and can produce the required opinions and invitation in English.
application_readiness_checklist: Download the Regulations appendix from the Bekker call folder - the actual scholarship amount and mobility allowance rates are set there, not on the programme pages
Secure your host centre invitation and the host supervisor's opinion first; without them the application cannot be completed
Ask your thesis advisor for the written opinion required for doctoral candidates early, since it is a named appendix in the call
Write the whole application in English - NAWA states applications must be prepared entirely in English
Check your host is not in the Russian Federation, which the programme's About page excludes
Confirm you have only one application in this call, since one application per call covering one host centre is the rule
common_rejection_risks: Losing the 3:00 pm Polish time cut-off because the NAWA ICT system submission, not the email, is what counts
Being based outside a Polish scientific or academic unit - this is an outgoing mobility programme for Polish institutions
Choosing a host in the Russian Federation, which is the one country the programme excludes
Submitting in Polish or mixed-language documents when the entire application must be in English
Trying to claim funding for more than one host centre in a single call
Missing the thesis advisor's opinion or the certification of doctoral student status, both of which are named appendices
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Not published as a figure. NAWA states the scholarship covers the holder's living expenses related to the stay plus a mobility allowance, and may be increased for a spouse and/or underage children or for the assistant of a holder with a severe or moderate disability - anything beyond those categories is on you.
document_audit: The document set is fixed by the call announcement's appendices: application form, host centre invitation, thesis advisor's opinion, certification of doctoral student status, host supervisor's opinion, model agreement and model reports
Every document must be in English, including the host centre invitation and the supervisor opinions
Doctoral candidates need certification of doctoral student status, which is a separate appendix from the thesis advisor's opinion - do not assume one covers the other
